data.verdict: phi_odd IS A PURELY 2-LOOP DATUM -- the classical bar-odd phase VANISHES (scope-(a)/(b) insight, independent of the sibling GGM strip). The 5_2 substrate has a real saddle (Re V=6.91, arg a=-pi/4, ray-absent) plus a CONJUGATE PAIR sigma_1/sigma_2 (Re V=1.815, Im V=+/-2.293). For that pair the classical amplitude 1/sqrt(i*delta) has arg-sum EXACTLY -pi/2 for BOTH the pair and its bar image, so the classical (1-loop) bar-odd phase is EXACTLY 0. Therefore the sibling's phi_odd=-0.004145 is generated ENTIRELY by the sub-leading QUANTUM amplitude (the certified 2-loop (238) correction) -- the classical geometric saddle data (V, delta) carries NO bar-odd datum, by conjugate symmetry. This is the MECHANISM behind the corpus's 'geometric routes are anchor-smooth/null' findings: the bar-odd datum is intrinsically quantum/2-loop, invisible to the classical volume/Hessian. Independently confirms the sibling 2-loop strip is essential, not optional. No fit; no c_k; no tier change.
